title: AI Platform
description: LiteLLM router, route validation, session memory. Source: bucket ai_metrics.

options.content: **Populates as the build plan lands.** Router panels fill in at Stage 1 (LiteLLM with `callbacks: ["prometheus"]` and `require_auth_for_metrics_endpoint: false`, ClusterIP only, Service `litellm` in namespace `litellm` port 4000). Route-validation panels fill in at Stage 2, memory panels at Stage 3. Both jobs write line protocol to bucket `ai_metrics`: `route_validation` (tags `check`=liveness|quality|qualification, `route`, `key`; fields `ok` 0/1 int, `latency_ms` float, `score` float 0-1) and `memory_distill` (tags `outcome`=ok|error|skipped, `domain`=personal|enterprise; fields `duration_ms` float, `pending_chats` int). Empty panels before then are expected.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric(_total)?$/)
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric(_total)?$/)
  |> increase()
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> sum()

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_proxy_total_requests_metric(_total)?$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["requested_model"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "requested_model"])

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_proxy_failed_requests_metric(_total)?$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["exception_class"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "exception_class"])

panels.title: Mean request latency (s)
panels.description: Histogram sum divided by count over each window, all routes together.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_request_total_latency_metric_(sum|count)$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> difference(nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_time", "_field"])
  |> sum()
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.litellm_request_total_latency_metric_count > 0.0)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, "mean latency": r.litellm_request_total_latency_metric_sum / r.litellm_request_total_latency_metric_count}))

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_deployment_state(_total)?$/)
  |> group(columns: ["litellm_model_name", "api_provider"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({model: r.litellm_model_name + " (" + r.api_provider + ")", state: r._value}))

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_deployment_successful_fallbacks(_total)?$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> derivative(unit: 1m, nonNegative: true)
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: sum, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "_field"])

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus" and r.service == "litellm" and r._field =~ /^litellm_deployment_failed_fallbacks(_total)?$/)

panels.title: Liveness, latest per route
panels.description: Hourly cheap ping. 0 means the route is dead and a removal should be proposed.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "route_validation" and r.check == "liveness" and r._field == "ok")
  |> group(columns: ["route", "key"])
  |> last()
  |> group()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({route: r.route + " (" + r.key + ")", "up (1/0)": r._value}))

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "route_validation" and r.check == "liveness" and r._field == "latency_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["route"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "route"])

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "route_validation" and r.check == "quality" and r._field == "score")

panels.title: Qualification results (latest 20)
panels.description: New OpenRouter candidates, including the panel-diversity check.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "route_validation" and r.check == "qualification" and r._field == "score")
  |> group()
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 20)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({time: r._time, route: r.route + " (" + r.key + ")", score: r._value}))

panels.title: Pending chats
panels.description: Chats with an undistilled leaf message, at the last sweep.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_distill" and r._field == "pending_chats")
  |> group()
  |> last()

panels.title: Minutes since last OK distill
panels.description: Time since the newest successful distillation in the last 7 days.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: -7d)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_distill" and r.outcome == "ok" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group()
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: float(v: int(v: now()) - int(v: r._time)) / 60000000000.0}))

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_distill" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["outcome"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: count, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "outcome"])

from(bucket: "ai_metrics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "memory_distill" and r.outcome == "ok" and r._field == "duration_ms")
  |> group(columns: ["domain"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "domain"])

panels.title: AI platform pod memory
panels.description: Namespaces litellm, open-webui, mcp*, ai-*. Empty until those exist.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telegraf")
  |> range(start: -5m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "kubernetes_pod_container" and r._field == "memory_working_set_bytes" and r.namespace =~ /^(litellm|open-webui|mcp.*|ai-.*)$/)
  |> group(columns: ["namespace", "pod_name", "container_name"])
  |> last()
  |> group(columns: ["namespace", "pod_name"])
  |> sum()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with pod: r.namespace + "/" + r.pod_name}))
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["pod", "_value"])
